description: Version 1.19 (gripper only; builds on 1.18, related pebble voice-07e1e6a1). Jake: make the section from where the finger starts rounding to the tip much thicker. Extend the width outward through that rounded section, but it should still come to a point at the tip.

results.identified_issue: Only trace_photo.py OUTER changed (straight_outer gained an optional out_deg start-tangent tilt): a=0.50 b=0.25 bow=0.20 out_deg=15 (1.18: 0.30/0.30/0.04/0). Picked from a small sweep in a scratch script measuring inner-to-outer width at 0/25/50/75/90/97% of dot->point: roughly 2x 1.18 mid-beak. The wider point changed the mesh's innermost reach (now equals the outline's 27.25066, no longer pulled in by tip_r), so the closed no-overlap check failed until gripper.scad contact_back was re-measured to +0.0005 (pivot 27.2512, also in poses.js). Larger bow or out_deg makes the nose blunter (arrival angle up to ~58 deg), so if Jake wants it sharper, reduce b/bow or add NOSE-like control near the tip. 'Thicker' was read as plan-view width per 'extend the width outward'; Z thickness taper is untouched. Registered in publish_designs.py ('1.19'), poses.js and VERSIONS.txt; render_compare run (front 98%).
results.summary: Version 1.19 is 1.18 with a much wider beak from the black dot to the tip, still closing to the same point.
results.detailed_description:
From the black dot, the outer edge now leans 15° outward and bows out before it rounds in to the point. Halfway to the tip the beak is 11.4 mm wide (1.18: 5.9 mm), and at three quarters it's 8.8 mm (1.18: 3.2 mm).

The inner jaw edge, the point, the tip-only contact, the holes, the grooves and 1.18's flat-bottom taper haven't changed. The six beak slots move outward to stay centred in the wider beak. All geometry checks pass. It hasn't been printed.

Have a look at the top and finger previews. The point now arrives blunter: the outer edge meets it at 56° off the axis, where 1.18's met it at 25°. Tell me if it should be sharper, or if the beak is now too wide.

summary: In version 1.19, the gripper finger's rounded section, from where rounding starts to the tip, is too thin. Thicken that section outward, building on 1.18, while the tip still tapers to a point.
